env.coach_coco_fertigate: Fertigate at least once daily with 10–20% runoff
env.coach_coco_fertigate_why: In coco, keep the media wet and run 10–20% runoff to stop salt build-up.
env.coach_coco_runoff_ec_why: Compare input vs runoff EC: far above input (≥1000 ppm) suggests a flush.
env.coach_curing_jars: Jar at 58–62% RH; burp daily week 1, every 2–3 days week 2
env.coach_curing_jars_why: Curing at the right RH smooths the smoke and develops aroma.
env.coach_drying_conditions: Dry at 60–68 °F, RH 50% then ~55% until stems snap
env.coach_flower_late_rh: Lower RH in late flower to protect from mould
env.coach_flower_late_rh_why: Late flower RH above ~62% at week 7+ is a mould risk.
env.coach_flower_stretch: Raise the lamp 2–4 in during stretch
env.coach_flower_stretch_why: Plants can double in height during the first 1–3 weeks of flower.
env.coach_hydro_reservoir: Log reservoir pH and EC trends
env.coach_hydro_reservoir_why: In hydro, reservoir management replaces soil wet–dry cycles.
env.coach_seedling_rh_why: Young roots can't drink enough; high RH keeps them hydrated.
env.coach_soil_wet_dry: Water when the top 1–2 in of soil is dry
env.coach_soil_wet_dry_why: Soil prefers a wet–dry cycle; overwatering suffocates roots.
env.coach_vpd_when_off: (lights off: keep close to daytime; watch the RH spike)
env.coach_vpd_why: VPD drives transpiration and nutrient uptake; the band shifts by phase and lights state.
env.heading: Environment
env.lamp_canopy_hot_dim: Canopy is hot: dim to ~80% or raise ~2 in.
env.lamp_canopy_hot_raise: Canopy is hot: raise the lamp ~2 in.
env.lamp_default: Set the distance by stage, then fine-tune with the dimmer. These are starting points — a PAR meter calibrates them.
env.lamp_dimmed_closer: Dimmed to 50%: the lamp can hang about 30% closer.
env.lamp_light_sensitive: This plant is light-sensitive: err toward the higher end.
env.lamp_light_tolerant: This plant is light-tolerant: the lower end may work.
env.lamp_range: {{ min }}–{{ max }} in / {{ cm_min }}–{{ cm_max }} cm from canopy
env.lamp_starting_points: These are starting points — a PAR meter or a PPFD-meter log entry calibrates them.
env.lamp_stress_dim: Bleaching or canoeing: dim to ~70–80% and re-check after a week.
env.lamp_stress_raise: Bleaching or canoeing: raise 2–4 in and re-check after a week.
env.lamp_stretch_raise: Stretch logged: raise 2–4 in as plants grow.
env.no_feed_entries: No feed entries in this window.
env.not_measured_hint: No sensor is bound for these readings — each chart appears once one is.
